lead: Virat Kohli is an Indian cricketer, born on 5 November 1988 in Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 37 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Delhi cricket team and has been recognised with Padma Shri in sports and Arjuna Award.
Below you will find a verified overview of Virat Kohli: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Virat Kohli — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer as his main occupation.

On the team sheet, Virat has been associated with India national cricket team (from 2011), Delhi cricket team (from 2006), Royal Challengers Bengaluru (from 2008) and India Under-19 cricket team (from 2006 to 2008). He plays as a batter.
